name: ahk-hotstring-clipper
description: Turn highlighted text into an AutoHotkey v2 hotstring, written by a local native host.

scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:go
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run build:host && npm run check:network && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:e2e && npm run build:host && npm run check:network && npm run e2e
